text:
deploy-bot: scheduled migration deploy: migration/2026-03-21-tenantid-enforce.sql to prod in 7m. Canary: 0.5% for 15m -> 5% for 15m. Holdpoint after canary. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/migrations/tenantid-enforce. rollback: revert PR #4321.
zara: FYI this touches user_profiles write path + index on (tenant_id). pin web-api to v3.13.0 for the window.
micah: pinning web-api now. @deploy-bot set service_pin=web-api@v3.13.0
deploy-bot: service_pin applied by micah.
lee-sre: note from staging: the backfill increased p99 db write latency by ~40ms when run concurrently. recommend starting canary with backfill paused, then enable backfill after stable second wave.
db-admin: backfill is idempotent and writes `tenant_migrated_at` on rows. script uses UPSERT by pk; safe to resume. we also have a migration_lock table to prevent concurrent runs.
ops-watch: replication lag on read replicas = 3s now. suggest not starting backfill if lag >6s. i'll monitor.
qa: propose we reduce initial canary to 0.25% and extend first watch window to 25m for signal on tail latency. less blast radius.
zara: agree 0.25% + 25m. escalation path: if stable -> 2% -> 5%. rollback triggers: >=0.2% 5xx or queue depth increase >25% sustained 5m.
micah: added changelog line about tenant_id null->not-null and rollback steps. pinged #support-alerts.
lee-sre: what's the fast pause command?
db-admin: use `deployctl pause migration/2026-03-21-tenantid-enforce.sql --who <your-name>` or UI pause. to abort: `deployctl abort --pr 4321`.
zara: starting canary in 5m at 0.25%. everyone ready?
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary 0.25% initiated.
ops-watch: initial metrics OK. read-replica lag 2s.
qa: seeing tiny p95 uptick in tokenization service, +30ms. watching.
lee-sre: tail latency should settle within 10m; if not we pause.
micah: i'm seeing a small uptick in DB transient errors (client write timeouts), currently 0.08%.
zara: continue watch. if errors hit 0.2% we trigger rollback.
ops-watch: replica lag drifted to 7s at 3587654650. pausing per pre-agreed threshold.
deploy-bot: deploy paused by ops-watch at 3587654650. reason: replica lag > threshold.
micah: thanks, i'll validate if lag caused the write timeouts.
db-admin: pausing any running backfill workers and checking replication slots.
qa: i'll run the smoke suite and surface any regressions.
zara: decision: hold here and let replicas catch up. if lag doesn't drop under 5s in 30m -> rollback. micah oncall for rollback.
ops-watch: will provide 5m snapshots; current plan to resume only after 3 consecutive snapshots under 4s.
micah: prepping rollback checklist now and verifying CI rollback job green.
db-admin: we can also run `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE tenant_id IS NULL;` to estimate remaining work if we need off-peak backfill.
lee-sre: add note to runbook: when pausing for lag, also check connection pool exhaustion on app hosts.
zara: ack. posting summary to #release-ops and will update this thread in 10m with metrics. :hourglass: 
deploy-bot: deploy remains paused. awaiting manual resume or rollback.
